_comment: Config for the EditorConfig job in .github/workflows/lint.yml.
Exclude: LICENSE and fonts/OFL.txt are verbatim licence texts that
AGENTS.md says stay byte-identical to what the licensor published, so
they are not ours to reindent. languages/*.mo is a compiled gettext
catalogue, i.e. binary, and screenshot.png likewise.
Disable.Indentation: .editorconfig sets indent_style = tab for every
file, which is right for PHP and CSS code but wrong for the things it
also catches: alignment spaces inside CSS and PHP comment blocks,
indented code fences in Markdown, and the shell command in the pull
request template. Tabs in PHP are enforced by PHPCS instead, where the
rule can apply to code and not to prose. What is left here still
catches the things that actually bite: CRLF, missing final newlines,
